gold.text: Users can use the filtering tool to quickly locate work items by responsible person or specific status.
The system must synchronize the status immediately after a task moves across columns to ensure that the Kanban layout remains up-to-date after the page is refreshed.
The deadline selector should restrict invalid date inputs, and for overdue tasks, the system must provide a prominent overdue indicator on the card.
When creating a project, the deadline must be in a valid date format and cannot be a past date.
When no matching results are found, the system should display an empty status "No matching task found" instead of displaying an error page.
When a user drags a task card, a placeholder dashed box or a highlighted tooltip should appear at the target location to provide clear placement feedback.
After applying filters (such as "responsible person"), unmatched tasks should immediately disappear or become transparent, while matched tasks should have a prominent visual focus.

pred.text: Active visual state for applied filter

gold.text: When opening and closing the task details modal, there should be a smooth transition animation, and the overlay should be clickable to quickly close it.
When a user saves an edit or submits a note, the system should display an immediate visual confirmation message saying "Saved".
The front of the task card must clearly display the title, the person in charge's photo (or initials), and the countdown to the deadline or the specific date.
The "Remarks/Updates" section in the task details should be arranged in reverse chronological order and clearly indicate the publisher and publication time.
The headings of each column on the Kanban board (such as To Do / In Progress / Done) and the total number of tasks they contain must be displayed accurately.
